stats.text:
The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.

Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren’t wearing armor, your base {ref:glossary/armor-class} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.
